M L Yeung (FAMILY KNIGHT) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that near the 250 Metres he allowed his mount to shift out when not clear of AESTHETICISM, resulting in AESTHETICISM being badly crowded and taken out onto TYCOON EXPRESS and also contributing to TYCOON EXPRESS becoming badly crowded to the inside of MASSIVE GLORY. M L Yeung was suspended from riding in races for one Hong Kong raceday to be conducted on Wednesday, 13 May 2026 at Happy Valley. In assessing penalty, the Stewards determined the carelessness grade 2 and the consequences grade 2 and also considered his excellent race riding record. J Moreira reported that after receiving interference near the 250 Metres he had some concern with his mount’s action thereafter. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

8 1 ABSOLUTE HEART (L226) 1 K C Leung Delayed the start when it proved difficult to load. He said as a result when placed under pressure in the Home Straight his mount found it difficult to respond to his riding, particularly under its top weight of 132 lbs and also resented the kickback as it was giving ground in the Home Straight. General

1.

After the running of Race 1, the track classification for the turf course was officially changed from "Good” to "Good to Firm”. This change in the opinion of the Stewards should be recorded as being retrospective. As a consequence of this, the official results will show Race 1 being run on a track rated "Good to Firm”.

2.

Trainer D Eustace was fined the sum of $2,000 for entering L388 in a barrier trial on Friday, 24 April 2026 when that horse was not named at the time of entry.

3. Whip Rule Offences – 22 April 2026 Happy Valley Racemeeting

The following jockey was found to be in breach of Rule 100(3)(ii)(a) for using the whip on consecutive occasions:-
Race 8 (632)
A Badel (THE AUSPICIOUS) – 4 consecutive strides between the 150 Metres and the 100 Metres – A fine of $8,000

Race 2 (626)
C L Chau (PODIUM) was fined the sum of $5,000 in relation to using his whip in a manner where the hand holding the whip was above shoulder height on two occasions between the 100 Metres and the winning post.
A Atzeni (ATOMIC BEAUTY) was warned in relation to using his whip in a manner where the hand holding the whip was above shoulder height on one occasion near the 450 Metres.

Race 6 (630)
A Atzeni (HAPPY UNITED) was fined the sum of $10,000 in relation to using his whip in a manner where the hand holding the whip was above shoulder height on one occasion near the 200 Metres.
